description.plain:
BESSEY® 6" Ratcheting Lever Clamps are a versatile addition to any shop. Designed for use with multifunction work tables with 20 mm holes, the uses for these clamps are endless. They securely hold workpieces in place for planing, sawing and other woodworking tasks. Use them with your shop-made jigs and fixtures or to create a clamping table. All that is required is a work surface with 20 mm holes and a panel thickness of at least 19 mm.


Features:


  • Fast, easy and safe clamping on tables with 20 mm holes
  • 6" clamping capacity allows for working with thicker materials
  • Securely holds workpieces without slipping
  • Quick-release trigger for immediate clamp release
  • Lightweight magnesium sliding arm for rapid, vibration-free clamping

Specifications:

  • Clamping Capacity: 6"
  • Throat Depth: 3"
  • Clamping Force: Up to 150 lb
  • Approximate Weight: 1.43 lb
  • Table or Panel Thickness Required: 19 mm or greater

What's Included:

  • (2) Bessey® 6" Ratcheting Lever Clamp for 20 mm MFT Style Table

description.plain:
Description

Take your IGT setup beyond the frame.

The Stanluck Universal Clamp transforms virtually any edge into a mounting point for your favorite IGT accessories. Whether you're attaching it to a railing, picnic table, kitchen countertop, or workbench, it lets you bring versatility wherever you need it.

Designed with the same modular philosophy as our IGT system, the Universal Clamp features integrated mounting holes for lantern poles, table extensions, and compatible accessories, along with a precision-machined sliding slot that accepts Stanluck bamboo tabletops. In seconds, you can create a compact side table, mount lighting, or expand your workspace, without needing an IGT frame.

Its heavy-duty clamping mechanism securely attaches to surfaces up to 1.75 inches thick, providing a stable foundation for cooking, dining, organizing, or relaxing wherever your adventure takes you.

Because your setup shouldn't be limited to one table.

Sold in pairs. 

One clamp. Endless possibilities. Expand your workspace anywhere and bring the flexibility of the Stanluck modular ecosystem beyond the IGT frame.

Key Features

  • Converts virtually any tabletop, railing, countertop, or flat edge into a modular IGT-compatible mounting point
  • Compatible with surfaces up to 1.75in (44mm) thick
  • Precision sliding slot accepts Stanluck bamboo tabletops for instant side tables or work surfaces
  • Integrated mounting holes support lantern poles, table extensions, and compatible IGT accessories
  • Heavy-duty clamping mechanism provides a secure, stable hold without permanent installation
  • CNC-machined aluminum construction for durability with minimal weight
  • Available in Black and Silver finishes
  • Quick, tool-free installation and adjustment

Compatibility
All IGT frames, extensions, and more

Material
Stainless Steel

media.alt_text: IGT Universal Clamp holding a bamboo board to an IGT frame

description.plain:
Diamond Painting Canvas Table Clamps are the perfect solution for keeping your canvas out of the way while diamond painting!

Our 3D printed holder securely holds your rolled-up canvas, freeing up space on your table. Now you can easily focus on perfecting your diamond painting without the canvas getting in your way.

Simply attach the single middle clamp to the center of the table and insert your rolled up diamond painting, and unrolling the canvas a little at a time as needed, perfect for small desk & Tables with a big canvas, works fine with are without Drills.

How To Video By Casey:

https://www.tiktok.com/@casey_spacey1/video/7657264940423646478?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc

Can accommodate up to a 2-1/4'' in thickness Desktop . 

Colors may vary slightly due to filament availability. Rainbow, Dual, and Tri colors have a random pattern. so every print will be different.

 They are 3D printed items so there might be some slight imperfections, but it does not interfere with functionality. If you have any issues, reach out to us thru the contact tab.

Material

99mm L x 20mm W x 70mm H (3.9 x 0.8 x 2.8in)

Color

Silvery

Max.Clamping

50mm (1.97'')

 

T-Track for CNC 3040/4030 Series

Upgraded clamps that are heavier duty and reliable solutions for keeping your T-Track or T-slot workpieces in place. Compatible with Genmitsu PROVerXL 4030 MDF Spoilboard and 6060 Extension Aluminum Spoilboard. Also, it can be used for other larger MDF Spoilboard and Aluminum Spoilboard that fits the size of the M6 T-slot nut (16 x 16mm).

 

Remove T-slot slide can be compatible with: 

PROVerXL 6050 Plus, PROVerXL 4030, 4040-RENO, 4040-PRO, 3030-PROVer MAX, 3020-PRO MAX V2, 3018-PROVer V2

 

Feature

Made of high-strength aluminum alloy which can provide you with high-tension clamping action. The star knob gives you full-range control. This makes adjusting, tightening, and securing your material a breeze.

 

Unique Groove Design

Two grooves on the top are designed for a stronger and more solid clamping force. Compared to other fixtures on the market, there are two different options available for you to choose: Choose the size range that best suits your materials.
